test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

He was consulted seldom by his colleagues while making important decisions on financial matters.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect placement of the adverb "**seldom**."
 
• Adverbs of frequency typically come after the verb "was." The correct construction should be "**was seldom consulted**.
 
• The proper phrase should be "**He was seldom consulted**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**He was** **seldom consulted** by his colleagues while making important decisions on financial matters."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "decisions on financial matters."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "by his colleagues"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "while making important"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
